report.policyFinding: Booking.com and its help pages state that 'free cancellation' means you can cancel your booking for free within the time frame specified by the property. If you cancel within this window, any prepayment or deposit is returned to you. However, if you cancel after the free cancellation period ends, you may be charged a fee or lose your prepayment. The specific deadline and refund conditions are set by each property and shown during booking and in your confirmation email.
report.explanation: 'Free cancellation' on Booking.com means you can cancel without penalty only if you do so within the property's specified free cancellation window. After that deadline, cancellation fees or loss of prepayment may apply. Always check the exact cancellation policy for your specific booking, as terms vary by property and room type. If you prepaid and cancel within the free window, you should get your money back. If you cancel after the window, you may not.
importantConditions: The free cancellation period is set by the property and may vary (often 24–48 hours before check-in, but can be different).
If you cancel after the free cancellation deadline, you may be charged a fee or lose your prepayment.
Refunds for prepayments or deposits are only guaranteed if you cancel within the free cancellation window.
Always check your booking confirmation for the exact policy and deadline.

evidence.excerpt: A “free cancellation” policy means you can change or cancel a booking for free, as long as you do it within the time frame specified by the property (e.g. “Cancel up to x days” or “Cancel before mm/dd/yy hh:mm”). This is mentioned in the conditions during the booking process and in the booking confirmation.
If you're eligible for free cancellation, this amount is returned to you when you cancel your booking.

Refundable rates typically cost slightly more but allow free cancellation within a specified timeframe, usually 24–48 hours before your scheduled arrival. Non-refundable rates may sometimes offer lower prices but come with stricter cancellation terms.

If you have a free cancellation booking, you won't pay a cancellation fee. If your booking isn't free to cancel anymore or is non-refundable, you may incur a cancellation fee. Any cancellation fees are determined by the property, and you'll pay any additional costs to the property.
